candidates.v70_SCARF: contrastive pretraining plus full-network supervised fine-tuning

reference: v44_seed_ensemble, reconstructed with the original three seeds, contrasts and spatial expert; v6 remains the existing gate reference

source.implementation: Independent local PyTorch implementation of Algorithm 1, not an author-provided package

outer_validation: Existing fixed development 6954 rows, three StratifiedKFold folds and unchanged seed20261112. No old holdout scoring or outer-label tuning.
inner_validation: Stratified 80/20 of the current outer-training rows, random_state equal to the current model seed; identical rows for scratch and SCARF.

input.missing_flags: Seven numeric missing indicators, stored as binary scalars; unlike FT-Transformer they are not separate categorical tokens. This encoding is shared exactly by SCARF and scratch.
input.numeric_encoding: log1p five spending columns, training-only median imputation and StandardScaler-equivalent population mean/std. All-missing columns use zero fallback, constant scales use one.
input.categorical_encoding: Training-only one-hot vocabulary; unknown index0 and missing index1 are explicit, observed categories start at2.
input.fit_boundary: Preprocessor fits only the applicable labeled training attributes. Test attributes never change vocabulary, median or scaling.

corruption.mechanism: Sample exactly seven original feature groups without replacement per row; each selected group uses an independent uniform donor from the applicable pretraining training pool.
corruption.integrity: Copy numeric value plus its missing flag together, and categorical one-hot blocks together. Never corrupt individual one-hot bits.
corruption.training_rng: Seeded numpy generators; new training corruptions each pass
corruption.validation_rng: Ten fixed seeded corruption passes and fixed batch memberships, generated once per pretraining epoch-selection phase. Validation donors exclude the unsupervised validation partition.

self_supervised_objective: Directional N-by-N clean-anchor/corrupted-view InfoNCE, diagonal positives, off-diagonal negatives, cosine similarity and temperature1. No target labels or teacher predictions.
supervised_objective: BCEWithLogitsLoss on clean labeled rows; discard projection head and train both encoder and classification head.
paper_stopping_defaults: The paper uses pretraining patience3 and cap1000; supervised patience3 with classification-error selection and cap200. Its ten passes construct fixed validation corruptions, not patience. Our patience10/40, supervised cap500 and logloss stopping are deliberate local training-adequacy adaptations, not original paper defaults.
unlabeled_pool: Only applicable training attributes plus actual4277 test attributes. Inner validation, outer validation and the old holdout are absent. During final export full8693 training attributes plus4277 test attributes are permitted.
unlabeled_split: A seeded random10percent split of the applicable unlabeled pool selects pretraining epochs. It is an attribute-only stopping set, not an independent Transported holdout. This is the final implementation choice superseding the proposal's test-only attribute stopping partition.
phase_sequence_per_outer_fold: Fit inner preprocessor only on inner labeled training attributes.
SCARF phase1: initialize contrastive network; select Epre using the90/10 unlabeled split and fixed validation corruptions.
SCARF phase2: initialize a fresh contrastive network and train on the complete inner-training-plus-test attribute pool for exactly Epre epochs.

Select Esup on labeled inner validation after supervised training of that pretrained encoder and a new classifier head. Scratch uses the identical labeled split, architecture and supervised protocol without pretraining.
Freshly fit outer preprocessor on all outer-training attributes.
SCARF phase3: initialize a fresh contrastive network and pretrain the complete outer-training-plus-test attribute pool for the already-selected Epre epochs; do not reselect Epre.

Initialize the supervised network, load this outer pretrained encoder for SCARF, and train all outer labels for the selected Esup epochs. Scratch initializes and trains independently for its selected Esup.
Predict outer validation once. Never select epochs or corruption settings using its labels.
budget_accounting: SCARF has three pretraining phases and two supervised phases per outer fold. Record every phase's actual rows, epochs, optimizer steps, losses and wall time, plus the full fit duration. The selected Epre and Esup transfer as epoch counts to larger refit pools; corresponding optimizer-step counts increase and are explicitly logged. Scratch has two supervised phases. No low wall-clock cap is silently substituted for these training budgets; root freezes resource budgets only after an exclusive device probe.
training_adequacy: Cap-hit flags and full curves are recorded. A still-improving cap, interrupted run or invalid gradients are inconclusive, not evidence against the method family.
serialization: Fitted preprocessor and CPU classifier state_dict are persisted with copied architecture settings and metadata; no GPU training engine, donor pool or projection head is needed at inference. Inference falls back to CPU when MPS is unavailable and records its actual device. Training never silently switches devices.
resources: Process RSS is a lifetime maximum and MPS readings are snapshots, not continuous GPU memory peaks.
reporting: Report complete OOF accuracy/logloss and per-fold differences against matched scratch and v44, along with parameter count/time/memory and training adequacy. A single recipe losing does not invalidate SCARF or MLP as a family.
risks: Marginal corruption can break meaningful CryoSleep/spending dependencies.
Pretraining epoch selection and outer refit use different pool sizes and fitted encodings.
The method may improve representation quality without improving accuracy at threshold0.5.
permission_boundary: Only synthetic CPU validation is authorized for this implementation handoff. Root manages real data/MPS probes, complete CV, commits and any later online approval.
